info.title: API.SH: Standvirtual
info.description: The Standvirtual API from API.SH: public Standvirtual data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A dealer's Standvirtual page: name, description, logo, cover image, member since, active listings, address, coordinates, opening hours, branches with their own addresses and hours, categories, and its stock (30 per page: id, link, title, gross and net price, make, model, version, year, mileage, fuel, photos). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/standvirtual-dealer

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The dealer's <name>.standvirtual.com link in any form, or its subdomain.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Standvirtual listing: title, status, dates, price (gross, net, price drop), make, model, version, year and month, mileage, fuel, gearbox, drive, body, engine size, power, colour, doors, seats, origin, registrations, warranty and inspection dates, road tax, every parameter, the equipment list by group, description, photos and the dealer (name, page, website, logo, badges, address, coordinates, opening hours, contact phone numbers). Private sellers come back as `private` with the name, badges and town the site shows (`private_seller`), never a phone. Pass `latest=1` with any search filter to read the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/standvirtual-listing

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Listing link (standvirtual.com/carros/anuncio/<slug>-ID....html) in any form, or the listing id (ID8Q1jYe).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: 1 = the first listing of a search with the other params (search filters).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every make in a category with its live listing count, or one make's models with counts, plus every search filter the category offers (id, label, input type) and the values of each enum filter with counts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/standvirtual-makes

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: A make id (bmw, mercedes-benz...) to list its models.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Standvirtual's market price range for a listing (low and high, EUR), where the listing's price sits (BELOW, IN, ABOVE) and when it was evaluated. 404 when the site has no evaluation for the listing. Pass `latest=1` with search filters to use the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/standvirtual-price-evaluation

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric listing id from search results (e.g. 8097747226), or a listing link in `url`.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: 1 = use the first listing of a search with the other params.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Cars, motorcycles, vans, motorhomes, trucks and boats for sale on Standvirtual (Portugal) with the site's filters: category, make, model, location and radius, year, price, mileage, power, engine size, battery and range, fuel, gearbox, body type, drive, colour, doors, seats, origin, condition, seller type and the site's flags, keywords and any other site filter by its own name (e.g. `filter_enum_apple_carplay=1`), plus sort and paging (32 per page). Each result has id, link, title, price and currency, make, model, version, year, mileage, fuel, gearbox, engine size, power, city, region, seller type and the dealer (name, page, logo). Private sellers are never named. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/standvirtual-search

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Make slug as in Standvirtual links (bmw, mercedes-benz, vw...).

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model slug as in Standvirtual links (318, 320, golf...). Needs make.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: District or city slug as in Standvirtual links (lisboa, porto, braga...).

parameters.name: fuel
parameters.description: Fuel types, comma-separated: gaz (petrol), diesel, electric, gpl, gnc, hibride-gaz, hibride-diesel, plugin-hybrid, hidrogen.

parameters.name: body_type
parameters.description: Body types, comma-separated: cabrio, combi, city-car, coupe, minivan, mini, sedan, suv, compact.

parameters.name: drive
parameters.description: Drive types, comma-separated: front-wheel-drive, rear-wheel-drive, integral.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Colours, comma-separated (black, white, silver, gray, blue, red...).

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version slug as in Standvirtual links.

parameters.name: registrations
parameters.description: Number of previous registrations, comma-separated: 0 ... 6, more-than-6.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A standvirtual.com search link instead of the filters above (any form).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The listings Standvirtual recommends next to a listing, in its groups (same dealer, similar cars) with what each group matched on; each with id, link, title, price, make, model, version, year, mileage, fuel, gearbox, power, engine size, body type, city, region and photos. Pass `latest=1` with search filters to use the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/standvirtual-similar

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric listing id from search results (e.g. 8097747226), or a listing link in `url`.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: 1 = use the first listing of a search with the other params.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
